name: WFSim
description: WFSim is a Warframe weapon calculator. It builds a loadout, simulates the fight against a named enemy, and searches for the best mods. Every formula cites its source, and every golden test is calibrated against a real in-game run. A board score belongs to its ruler, the named benchmark fight: compare scores only under one ruler, quote the ruler with the number, and give the reader the row's link, which opens the build in the calculator.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Optional. An agent key raises the allowance; https://wfsim.app/auth.md issues one.

skills.name: builder_weapons_find
skills.description: Find weapons by name, in any language WFSim speaks. Send a data part {"skill": "builder.weapons.find", "args": {...}}; args: {"query":{"type":"string","description":"name words, in any language WFSim speaks"},"limit":{"type":"number","description":"rows to return, default 12"}}.

skills.name: builder_board_read
skills.description: Read a weapon's leaderboard: the measured best builds per ruler (the benchmark fight), mode, and with or without a riven, ranked. Each row carries the link that opens it, and a riven-free row its `build`, which the stats read takes. Send a data part {"skill": "builder.board.read", "args": {...}}; args: {"weapon":{"type":"string","description":"weapon id; on the page, the one open when omitted"},"riven":{"type":"string","description":"\"without\" (default), \"with\" or \"any\"","enum":["without","with","any"]},"mode":{"type":"string","description":"only this mode id"},"limit":{"type":"number","description":"rows per group, default 3"},"distinct":{"type":"boolean","description":"one row per score; `limit` counts scores"},"pooled":{"type":"boolean","description":"rank a ruler's modes together"}}.

skills.name: builder_stats_read
skills.description: Read the stats panel for a build: every stat per form and part, base and final, with the mod each change came from, and what the weapon's model does not cover. Send a data part {"skill": "builder.stats.read", "args": {...}}; args: {"build":{"type":"object","description":"the build: {weapon, mods: [mod ids], arcane: [arcane ids], evolutions: [ids], mode} — a board row's `build` is one; on the page, the one on screen when omitted"}}.

skills.name: builder_rivens_read
skills.description: The Riven Analyst: each riven the board measured for a weapon, its best score against the #1 riven-free build of the same ruler and mode — what the riven is worth. Only submitted rivens appear. Send a data part {"skill": "builder.rivens.read", "args": {...}}; args: {"weapon":{"type":"string","description":"weapon id; on the page, the one open when omitted"},"ruler":{"type":"string","description":"only this benchmark id"},"mode":{"type":"string","description":"only this mode id"},"bonuses":{"type":"array","description":"stat ids each riven has as bonuses","items":{"type":"object"}},"malus":{"type":"string","description":"the malus: a stat id, \"any\" or \"none\""},"pooled":{"type":"boolean","description":"a ruler's modes as one ranking"}}.
